Sobre a Coimpa

Reduzindo as emissões nocivas dos veículos. Alimentando os carros do futuro. Dando nova vida aos metais usados.

Continuamos a fornecer soluções de materiais sustentáveis que atendem às megatendências globais e são essenciais para a vida cotidiana. Nossos produtos e serviços aceleram a transformação da mobilidade global, atendem à crescente necessidade de materiais avançados e permitem uma circularidade ainda maior para metais críticos. Somos a empresa líder em tecnologia de materiais circulares, cumprindo sua missão de criar valor sustentável por meio de materiais para uma vida melhor.

Com ambições como essa, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Sobre o Laboratório

Uma organização global. Não são apenas nossas unidades industriais e centros técnicos vitais para o crescimento da Umicore. Em todas as nossas funções de apoio garantimos a continuidade de nosso crescimento e evolução, seja garantindo a viabilidade comercial de nossas decisões, maximizando nossa reputação e construindo novos relacionamentos, quanto encontrando as pessoas adequadas para continuar a partir de onde já alcançamos. A variedade de nossos resultados significa que não podemos ficar parados. Precisamos encontrar novas maneiras de trabalhar, descobrindo novas soluções e desenvolvendo novas ideias. E é aqui que você entra.

O que você fará

  • Vaga para trabalhar em 2º turno
  • Efetuar a gestão técnica da equipe, estabelecendo/ajustando o fluxo de preparação de amostras, bem como efetuar o gerenciamento de tempo garantindo o atendimento dentro do prazo correto;
  • Fornecer auxílio para a gestão em relação a: tratativas de não conformidade e manutenção dos índices dos indicadores da área;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe, garantido-os recursos técnicos para seu desenvolvimento;
  • Executar análises químicas e físico químicas; elaborar e revisar métodos analíticos e instruções de serviços do laboratório;
  • Validar resultados analíticos no sistema LIMS, assegurando que todos os critérios estatísticos estejam dentro do aceito, além de efetuar a liberação no sistema SAP;
  • Atuar nas rotinas de gestão técnica dos funcionários sob sua responsabilidade, orientando-os sobre procedimentos operacionais e de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente, gerenciando comportamentos e performances, planejando, dimensionando e distribuindo as demandas de trabalho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar e/ou participar do treinamento de novos analistas na execução das atividades do laboratório;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento das tarefas não-analíticas como: conservação, limpeza e organização dos equipamentos e instalações do laboratório, retirada de insumos no almoxarifado para abastecimento interno.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Química
  • Inglês intermediário B1
  • Desejável experiência de 4 anos em rotinas de laboratório de controle de qualidade ou de processos industriais
  • CRQ nível superior
  • Excel avançado
  • Forte conhecimento técnico em química analítica, estatística e tratamento de dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema LIMS e SAP

Diferencial

  • Mestrado em química de materiais, analítica, físico-química ou inorgânica;
  • Curso de quimiometria;
  • Experiência anterior com ICP-OES, XRF, técnicas gravimétricas clássicas.
  • Experiência em implementação de melhorias analíticas e validação analítica de metodologia;

O que oferecemos

Nosso objetivo é estar à frente. Não apenas para nossos clientes, mas também para nossos funcionários. É por esse motivo que buscamos um ambiente colaborativo no qual todos possamos ter sucesso, promovendo uma cultura de compartilhamento de ideias, desenvolvimento de nossa capacidade e avanço em nossas carreiras. Estamos empenhados na construção de uma cultura inclusiva que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todos, independentemente de suas origens. Como seria de esperar de uma empresa líder mundial, também recompensaremos sua contribuição com salários e benefícios competitivos. Com tudo isso e muito mais, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Coimpa, nos empenhamos na construção de um local de trabalho inclusivo e diverso que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todas as pessoas. Contratamos independente de religião, raça, nacionalidade, etnia, origem cultural, grupo social, deficiência, orientação sexual, estado civil e opinião política.

Valorizamos a singularidade de cada pessoa e acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos nos ajuda a encontrar as soluções certas em um ambiente competitivo e dinâmico, afinal equipes diversificadas contribuem para ambientes mais criativos e inovadores e garantem o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, tornando a Coimpa um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

Se você compartilha os mesmos valores, inscreva-se para fazer parte de nossa equipe!

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer to help design, manage, and automate our private cloud infrastructure . This role requires deep expertise in on-premises infrastructure —including physical servers, storage, virtualization (VMware & other hypervisors), and networking —combined with a strong DevOps mindset and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) approach . You will play a key role in modernizing infrastructure operations using GitOps methodologies , ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and fully automated .

We are open to hiring for this position in Lisbon, Portugal, and São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Private Cloud Management : Oversee and optimize on-premises infrastructure , including VMware and other hypervisors, physical servers, and storage solutions .
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : Implement and enforce GitOps workflows , automating provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, and other IaC tools .
  • Virtualization & Compute : Manage and optimize virtualization environments (VMware vSphere, ESXi, KVM, etc. ).
  • Storage & Networking : Design and manage storage solutions (SAN, NAS, SDS) and work with networking components (VLANs, Load Balancers, DNS, etc.) .
  • Automation & CI/CD : Develop and maintain automation for infrastructure deployment, monitoring, and maintenance via GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and configuration management .
  • Observability & Monitoring : Ensure system reliability through Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar monitoring solutions .
  • Security & Compliance : Implement security best practices, including IAM, role-based access control (RBAC), system hardening, and compliance with industry standards .
  • Collaboration & Documentation : Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve infrastructure scalability, reliability, and automation processes .

Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in infrastructure engineering, with expertise in building, deploying, and managing global infrastructure systems.
  • Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge of Red Hat Linux/Rocky Linux (or similar) and Linux system administration.
  • Virtualisation: Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi for managing virtualised environments (installation, configuration, troubleshooting).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficient in Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and Puppet for automating infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • HCI (Hyper-Converged Infrastructure): Experience designing, deploying, and managing HCI solutions.
  • Kubernetes & Containerisation: Expertise in Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) for container orchestration.
  • Networking: Deep understanding of high-performance networking, SR-IOV, NFV, and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS).
  • System Architecture: Knowledge of hardware concepts (disk subsystems, memory, CPU, NICs, RAID, I/O subsystems, HBA, iSCSI, Fiber Channel, Ethernet) and performance optimisation.
  • Security & Compliance: Experience with system hardening, compliance frameworks (CIS, GDPR), and IAM systems (OpenLDAP, Active Directory, PAM).
  • Monitoring & Observability: Expertise in tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Loki for system monitoring and proactive issue resolution.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and contributing to infrastructure automation.
  • Scripting & Programming: Proficient in Python, Bash, or Go for infrastructure management and automation.
  • Storage Technologies: Familiar with SDS (Software Defined Storage) and data protection strategies (backup, disaster recovery).
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to resolve infrastructure issues under pressure.
  • Continuous Learning: Passionate about staying up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices in infrastructure.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

Analista de Inteligência de Mercado Sênior (Pesquisador)

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Atuar em parceria com diferentes departamentos da companhia como comercial de originação, logística, data science, trading, entre outros;
  2. Utilizar dados proprietários, dados e insights obtidos através de pesquisa com fontes externas e análise dos principais indicadores do setor de commodities agrícolas local e global, para atuar na construção dos balanços de oferta e demanda de soja, milho, algodão;
  3. Realizar estimativas de demanda interna de soja para crushing, milho, farelo e substitutos (como DDG’s) para ração animal, demanda de óleo no mercado doméstico (biodiesel, óleo envasado) a nível de estado;
  4. Realizar cruzamento de informações como produção agrícola, farmer selling e demanda, para auxiliar nas discussões de ownership do mercado;
  5. Criar e manter processos de modelagem de dados, incluindo elaboração de documentação de novos processos;
  6. Preparar análises setoriais e relatórios executivos, comunicar de forma efetiva potenciais desbalanços e insights obtidos de análises para todos os stakeholders da área, incluindo apresentações em inglês.

Qualificações

  1. Conhecimento dos processos de construção, manutenção e análise de balanços de oferta e demanda de soja, milho, algodão, trigo e subprodutos (farelo, óleo);
  2. Conhecimento sobre as principais variáveis que influenciam o mercado de commodities agrícolas (foco em soja, milho e algodão) para projeções de crushing, demanda doméstica de proteínas, fluxos logísticos e farmer selling;
  3. Conhecimento de técnicas estatísticas básicas para análise de dados e aplicação de métodos quantitativos na projeção das variáveis mencionadas, além de gestão e manipulação de diferentes bases de dados, internas e externas;
  4. Conhecimento sobre as principais variáveis que influenciam a formação da produção agrícola das principais commodities no Brasil e no mundo (foco soja, milho, trigo, algodão);
  5. Conhecimento de técnicas de análise exploratória de dados para análise descritiva, métodos estatísticos (regressão linear), análise de medidas de dispersão, entre outros;
  6. Desejável conhecimento de linguagem de programação, como Python e/ou R (Posit) como foco em pacotes como SciPy, Statsmodels, Numpy, Pandas, para alavancar a aplicação dessas técnicas estatísticas, além de Matplotlib e outros pacotes para visualização de dados;
  7. Excel (avançado para o uso de fórmulas, condições lógicas, manipulação de dados).
  8. Inglês avançado.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: Senior Data Reliability Engineer Curitiba | On-site
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

We are looking for a Senior Data Reliability Engineer to join our Software Engineering team responsible for our platform that facilitates the visualization and communication between EBANX and our merchants. You will be part of a team of experienced developers responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactions every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback and meritocracy.

As a DRE inside this team, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring the quality, reliability, and availability of data in large-scale systems;
  • Developing and maintaining robust, fault-tolerant data pipelines;
  • Implementing and improving monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues in real time;
  • Building and maintaining backup, recovery, and automation solutions to enhance data reliability;
  • Investigating and resolving data quality issues, such as inconsistencies and duplicates;
  • Collaborating with teams from different departments, including Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, to ensure efficient use of data;
  • Defining and monitoring data reliability metrics, like SLAs and SLOs, to maintain high standards;

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and deploying data solutions; the specific stack is not as important as a strong foundation;
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala;
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch);
  • Familiarity with big data platforms (Spark, Kafka) and data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow);
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of data security and reliability;
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud) and DevOps practices;
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting tools;
  • Active participation in technical discussions and decision-making processes to create scalable solutions;
  • Ability to share knowledge with the Software Engineering team;

What else we would love to see?

  • Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch;
  • Experience with deploying and monitoring cloud infrastructure, especially AWS;
  • Experience with software architecture;
  • Familiarity with challenges in data replication;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter;
  • The best tools so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others);
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error prone;
  • Frequent, fair and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • Meal Allowance;
  • Transportation voucher (if needed);
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Birthday Day Off;
  • Semi-flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics stores, and more!

description:
Especialista Gestão de Identidades - IAM

Join to apply for the Especialista Gestão de Identidades - IAM role at Porto .

Job Description

Na Porto , o Especialista em IAM (Identity and Access Management) é responsável por planejar, implementar, administrar e oferecer suporte contínuo às soluções de gerenciamento de identidade e acesso da organização.

Seu principal objetivo é assegurar que os usuários certos tenham os acessos apropriados aos sistemas e dados corporativos, sempre em conformidade com as políticas internas e os requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis.

Essa atuação é essencial para fortalecer a segurança da informação, garantir a governança de acessos e apoiar a conformidade com normas e auditorias internas e externas.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Desenvolver, configurar e administrar plataformas de IAM, como Okta, Azure AD, SailPoint, CyberArk, entre outras;
  • Gerenciar ciclo de vida de identidades: provisionamento, desprovisionamento e manutenção de contas de usuários;
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de controle de acesso baseadas em papéis (RBAC), atributos (ABAC) ou políticas híbridas;
  • Automatizar fluxos de trabalho de acesso e integração de sistemas ao IAM;
  • Realizar revisões periódicas de acessos e apoiar auditorias de conformidade (SOX, ISO 27001, LGPD, etc.);
  • Colaborar com times de TI e segurança na definição de requisitos de autenticação multifator (MFA), login único (SSO) e federado (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect);
  • Monitorar e investigar atividades suspeitas de acesso com apoio de ferramentas SIEM;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e promover treinamentos internos sobre boas práticas de segurança de identidade;
  • Definir os requisitos técnicos e modelos arquitetônicos de segurança da informação visando proteção das informações dos clientes e colaboradores da Porto;
  • Construção ou revisão dos desenhos, fluxos e diagramas de soluções tecnológicas contendo requisitos de SI ou soluções de SI novas e/ou anteriormente definidas;
  • Definição e/ou revisão e/ou pesquisa de controles de segurança da informação, focando em Tecnologia/Processos/Pessoas e elencando com a estratégia ameaças digitais reais versus vulnerabilidades aplicáveis aos negócios da Porto Seguro;
  • Definição clara e efetiva de controles de segurança tangíveis, eficientes e aplicáveis aos negócios da Porto Seguro;
  • Avaliação e comparação de soluções e fornecedores de SI eficientes, com foco sempre na visão do cenário de ameaças atuais e os riscos mapeados;
  • Pesquisa de soluções e fornecedores que sejam referência e inovadores, endereçando sempre os riscos cibernéticos aos quais os negócios da Porto Seguro estão sujeitos.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de IAM em ambientes corporativos;
  • Conhecimento prático em protocolos e ferramentas de autenticação/autorização;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes híbridos (on-premise e cloud);

Desejável

  • Certificações como: CIAM, CISSP, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), Okta Certified Professional, SailPoint IdentityNow;
  • Experiência com linguagens de script (PowerShell, Python, Bash);

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

title: Supervisor, Special Services (English Speaking)
description:
Are you an experienced Customer Service people manager and enthusiastic about the hospitality industry? Do you have experience in Salesforce Service Console or a similar omni-channel servicing platform? As Supervisor, Special Services (English Speaking) you will join LHW’s Global Servicing Team to lead the day-to-day management of our Customer Care team, focused on customer satisfaction and retention through exceptional issue management. You will collaborate with colleagues across the globe to develop a high-performance team focused on the best customer experience for LHW customers.
This is a full-time position located in Sao Paulo, Brazil. We offer flexible workplace policies that can accommodate candidates who are comfortable working in the office at least 2 days a week.

Key Goals & Objectives:

  1. Performance: Develop, Monitor and Achieve operational KPI targets for you and your team, including, but not limited to: first response time, case closure time, and NPS/CSAT score, etc., focused on customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
  2. Collaboration: Join your team on a regular basis handling customer requests when additional assistance is needed (high volume, high response times, escalation management).
  3. Team Management: Ensure your direct reports consistently understand and execute company and department strategy, tactics, operational guidelines, and procedures, as well as embody LHW’s core values, culture, and vision.
  4. Relationships: Work closely with the Global Servicing Managers, your peers worldwide, your direct reports, and other key stakeholders to fulfill the job’s purpose and deliver on required standards.
  5. Excellence: Achieve subject matter expertise across LHW Programs (Loyalty for B2B and B2C customers), Hotel product, and operational systems as point of escalation and resolution for issue management across stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  1. In English, handle customer emails, cases, and chat messages in an omni-channel framework, servicing current and potential clients and our member hotels in a timely and professional manner.
  2. Present features, benefits, and key differentiators of the LHW brand, LHW programs, and our member hotels during interactions with customers, leveraging skills and relationships to diffuse concerns and overcome obstacles.
  3. Maintain effective follow-up processes for pending requests and offer efficient expectation management throughout all interactions with internal and external customers.
  4. Maintain sound understanding and adherence to all LHW policies and procedures, both individually and collectively by the assigned team, such as commitment to safe handling of sensitive information and data and compliance with security guidelines.
  5. Verify and interpret data on member hotels, guests, and reservations, such as rate policies, room descriptions, membership status, policy compliance, and research all necessary additional details through online platforms: Central Reservations System, Salesforce Service Console, and other tools.
  6. Critically analyze intricate scenarios and present solutions to complex issues, soundly determining the appropriate next steps, and independently assessing when escalations are needed, while being ready to engage with difficult situations and challenging circumstances.
  7. Coach, guide, and supervise a small multicultural and hybrid team – remote and local –, ensuring they deliver on required company and department standards, goals, and guidelines.
  8. Function as subject matter expert on LHW programs and product as reference to outsourced reservations team.
  9. Perform routine managerial functions related to HR and administrative matters concerning your direct reports, as well as actively provide relevant feedback on performance.
  10. Run, maintain, and update reporting on department KPIs, interpret and present results to broader team, and implement necessary actions to drive meaningful improvements.
  11. Actively participate in team meetings, attend member hotel presentations and represent LHW at client events when needed.
  12. Act as subject matter expert and point of escalation for the Employee Stay Program, offering discounted hotel bookings to eligible member hotel employees.

This is just a sample of the work this role will require. You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at the company’s discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Requirements & Experience:

  1. Fluent English language, spoken and written.
  2. Bachelor’s Degree (Hotel Management, Tourism, Marketing, Business or similar preferred).
  3. 5+ years of customer service or related experience required.
  4. People management experience required.
  5. Hospitality, travel, or luxury experience preferred; international experience is a plus.
  6. Comfortable with Salesforce or similar ticketing and servicing platform and Microsoft Office: Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams (or similar business chat function), Word.

The ideal candidate will have:

  1. Ability to work well in a fast-paced, global, cross-functional, and collaborative environment.
  2. Solid reliability, coaching, trust-building, and interpersonal skills.
  3. Robust problem-solving and customer issue management skills.
  4. Strong organization, prioritization, and diligence.

title: Manager, Capacity Planning & Network Modeling
description:
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans and cups to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Position Overview:

Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. It involves analyzing infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designing agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Areas of Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify areas for optimization. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to logistics capacity and network performance.
  2. Utilize advanced modeling techniques and simulation tools to translate supply plans into optimal logistics networks considering factors such as transportation costs, lead times, inventory levels, and service requirements. Provide short-term analysis and recommendations on resilient network adaptations in response to unplanned capacity/demand changes that are limited in time.
  3. Engineer and oversee warehouse layout designs to maximize productivity and handle projected volume throughputs.
  4. Set and oversee global MHE (including automation) requirements and standards.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance, to align capacity planning efforts with business goals and objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources to implement capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, transportation fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Conduct regular reviews and audits of logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs and objectives.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning processes, tools, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced or fluent level of English.
  • Logistics Experience: Experience in logistics operations, understanding transportation, warehousing, and distribution processes; experience designing and optimizing logistics networks considering costs, lead times, and service requirements.
  • Capacity Planning: Experience forecasting demand, analyzing logistics capacity, and using modeling tools to optimize resources.
  • Network Modeling: Experience designing agile, cost-effective logistics networks using various tools and techniques.
  • Team Collaboration and Interpersonal Skills: Proven ability to collaborate across departments to align capacity planning efforts with business goals.

As a Sr. Solution Specialist, you will be the referent for SAP sales and distribution solutions, defining and establishing target solutions, making high-level design choices, and ensuring effective delivery of solutions in collaboration with technical teams.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Designing cross-process flows with team members.

You will also manage long-term relationships, define priorities, communicate effectively, and propose improvements to ensure continuous value addition.

You will be part of a global initiative, onboarded as a project team member in the S/4HANA roadmap, with responsibilities including managing SAP SD processes, making solution design decisions, and enabling long-term improvements.

Experience & Skills

Minimum 6 years of experience in large IT projects within an international environment. Skills include:

We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.

  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Aqui, cada conhecimento e diversidade se complementa e você pode trabalhar no que mais ama, estamos comprometidos a construir uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente no qual pessoas possam equilibrar a carreira com seus compromissos e interesses pessoais, prezando pelo bem-estar.

A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor. title: Collections Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Collections Analyst role at Ecolab Life Sciences

The Collections Analyst is responsible for collecting payments from delinquent customers, managing sales ledgers, and achieving monthly accounts receivable reduction targets. This involves reporting progress and issues to the collections leaders, assisting in enhancing Ecolab’s collection systems management, and providing detailed collection reports to the divisional business partners.

Responsibilities

  1. Handle incoming and outgoing calls and emails for payment collection.
  2. Update account statuses, including referrals, and transfer funds on accounts.
  3. Follow up on received payments and pursue remittance details.
  4. Identify and escalate queries promptly and request credit notes as needed.
  5. Clear cash accounts through transfers and manage direct debit failures.
  6. Reconcile banking discrepancies accurately.
  7. Allocate payments made via BACS, cheque, and credit card.
  8. Participate in projects aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of Ecolab’s credit management processes.
  9. Report monthly progress on activities, highlighting areas of concern to the collections leaders.

Basic Qualifications

  1. 3+ years of experience working in Collections teams.
  2. Proficiency in SAP.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business or a related field.
  2. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Access, or the ability to be trained.
  3. Credit experience and/or customer service experience related to large corporate customers.
  4. Experience in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, and Access).
  5. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  6. Effective oral and written communication skills.
  7. Demonstrated initiative and ability to work independently.
  8. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and process-oriented.
  9. Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
  10. Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Position: Business Intelligence Developer

GreenLight Biosciences is seeking a Business Intelligence Developer to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of data visualization solutions. Required Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  2. More than 2 years of working experience in scientific solutions, commercial or public research organizations handling diverse datasets.

  4. Familiarity with at least two database design and querying languages such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
  5. Experience with ERP systems such as TOTVS ERP, D365 F&O, Salesforce, etc.
  6. Agility and a solution-oriented mindset.
  7. Strong ownership and commitment to completing assignments.
  8. Excellent communication skills with diverse stakeholders.
  9. Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Life Science, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  2. Hands-on experience in data aggregation, cleaning, normalization, and visualization within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  3. Knowledge of financial, manufacturing, and lab processes and operations.
  4. Proficiency in Excel, including developing functions and VBA macros.
  5. Ability to interact with both data and non-data personnel to implement user requirements.
  6. Experience in software documentation and testing.

We are an innovative iGaming company offering a comprehensive suite of crypto-focused products, including sportsbook and casino experiences. Whether it’s through competitive sportsbook offerings or immersive casino gameplay, we are dedicated to creating a unique and engaging platform. Join us in shaping the future of crypto iGaming.

We’re seeking an experienced senior Software Engineer to architect and develop a next-generation iGaming product for both mobile and desktop. The ideal candidate will spearhead technical design, oversee the development lifecycle, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver a high-quality, robust, and innovative gaming experience.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Development: Lead the architecture and development of a high-performance, scalable iGaming product for both mobile and desktop web.

  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical strategy, direction, and guidance on best practices in software design, architecture, and implementation.

  • Collaboration: Coordinate with all stakeholders, including product management, design, and platform teams to ensure timely, high-quality releases.

  • Drive Code Quality: Implement and enforce coding standards, conduct code reviews, and champion best practices in security and performance.

  • Project Scoping and Planning: Work closely with stakeholders to define roadmaps, estimate timelines, and manage project priorities.

  • Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on industry trends, emerging frameworks, and technologies relevant to the iGaming space.

Work Experience and Skills

Essential Experience

  • 10+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of designing and building high-performance, customer-facing web applications.

  • Proven track record in developing and maintaining casino game backend systems or game engines.

  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party RNG providers and other essential iGaming services.

  • Strong experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures.

Essential Skills:

  • Tech Stack Proficiency: In-depth knowledge of modern frameworks (React, TypeScript, Next.js, or similar), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and databases (SQL/NoSQL).

  • Leadership Skills: Experience mentoring engineers and cultivating high-performance environments.

  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, problem-solving, and strategic thinking abilities.

Personal Qualities and Behavioral Traits

Essential Qualities and Behaviours:

  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

  • Strong communicator, able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams across different time zones.

  • High level of accountability and ownership over delivered features and system stability.

  • Passionate about delivering world-class user experiences through robust backend solutions.

  • Analytical thinker with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

Desirable Qualities and Behaviours:

  • Interest in blockchain, crypto technologies, and their application in gaming.

  • Enthusiastic about the gaming industry, particularly within the casino and sports betting sectors.

  • Open to experimenting with new technologies and approaches to stay at the cutting edge of innovation.

  • Mentor mindset with a desire to help others develop their skills.

Relationships

Key Internal Relationships:

  • Game Design Team – Collaborate on implementing game mechanics and math models.

  • Front-End Development Team – Ensure seamless API integration and data flow between backend and client-side applications.

  • DevOps/Infrastructure Team – Work together to optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Product Management – Align backend development with product roadmaps and feature priorities.

  • Compliance and Security Teams – Ensure backend systems meet regulatory requirements and security best practices.

What The Site Contract Department Does At Worldwide
Site Contracting is an essential function within any CRO, and our seasoned team spans decades of experience within the industry and possesses robust legal experience as well. The department is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and drafting clinical research site contracts, investigator contracts and other project-related contracts. Our global team is familiar with the specific laws for the countries and sites we occupy. We negotiate and finalize clinical trial contracts and services contracts with the Worldwide Legal Department, study teams, Sponsors, investigators, and/or clinical sites.
What Will You Do

  • Main point of contact for the Project Team and Sponsor, for all Study site contracting activities, during the life of contracting on the Study.
  • Serves as a Lead and Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Clinical Trial Agreement processes at the Study level and in accordance with the Contract and Budget Plan (CBP), outlining a strategy for the contract negotiation process and responsibilities.
  • Presents sites contract negotiation processes during Alignment / Launch meetings and provides update during internal and external team meetings until finalization of contracting activities.
  • Communicates and facilitates site contracting strategies, contract turnaround/execution timelines, and sites contract tracking requirements.
  • Accountable for Study level site contracting tracking tools completeness
  • Agrees and negotiates Clinical Trial Agreements templates, fall back language and sites budget negotiation parameters with Global Project Lead and Sponsor.
  • Supports, supervises, and mentors allocated Site Contracts Specialists, ensuring effective planning, effective communication, on time issues escalation, problem solving and execution.
  • Responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of Study site contracting updates to stakeholders
  • Recognizes potential problems/areas of concern and formulates contingency plans during the Clinical Trial Agreement development and escalates appropriately.
  • Develops and implements mitigation plan to ensure the Clinical Trial Agreement deliverables are met.
  • Works closely with the Global Project Lead, Site Activation Manager, Regulatory Affairs Manager and/or other departments/Leads to ensure delivery of fully executed agreements in support of timely Study site activation deliverables to meet departmental goals.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of, and ensures compliance with applicable ICHGCP Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, Worldwide SOPs and project specific procedures; maintains and assures quality of work generated.
What You Will Bring To The Role
  • Mastery in negotiating complex contract terms with clinical sites and vendors
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with internal stakeholders, clinical sites, Sponsors, and regulatory authorities, if required.
  • In-depth understanding of international and local regulatory requirements for clinical trials (e.g., FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP).
  • Ability to explain complex contract terms clearly and concisely
  • Leadership skills to guide and support junior contract specialists
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including but not limited to legal, finance, data protection and clinical operations.
Your Experience
  • Up to 2 years of experience as a Principal Site Contracts Specialist and 2 – 3 years’ experience leading projects or minimum 6 years Site Contract experience in Clinical Research, Pharmaceutical or CRO industry and 2 – 3 years’ experience leading projects
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in business administration, finance, science or related field.
  • Excellent verbal and written English language skills.
  • Proficiency with MS Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Knowledge and understanding of ICH and GCP Guidelines, as well as local country legislation in the sphere of clinical trials and local regulatory requirements
  • High degree of organizational, analytical, and team management skills.
  • Adept knowledge of the biopharmaceutical/CRO industry and applicable local regulatory requirements.

    • Document and standardize supply chain processes.
  • Inventory Management & Optimization:
    • Analyze inventory levels and implement strategies to optimize stock levels, minimize holding costs, and prevent stockouts.
    • Develop and maintain inventory control policies and procedures.
    • Utilize advanced Excel modeling to simulate inventory scenarios and assess impact of changes.
